listingDraft.shortDescriptionEs: Herramientas profesionales para operar tu negocio.
listingDraft.shortDescriptionEn: Professional tools for running your business.
listingDraft.fullDescriptionEs: AkiBusiness reúne herramientas operativas para negocios. Accede a funciones como punto de venta, inventario, clientes y operaciones de equipo según el plan y las funciones habilitadas para tu empresa. Trabaja con permisos de usuario y ubicaciones separados. Algunas herramientas requieren una suscripción o configuración adicional.
listingDraft.fullDescriptionEn: AkiBusiness brings business operations together. Access point-of-sale, inventory, customer and team operations where your plan and workspace support them. Use location-scoped tools and user permissions. Some functions require an eligible subscription or additional setup.

sourceObservation: Production akibusiness.com is a Cloudflare CNAME to akibusiness-operations-preview.pages.dev, served from elguiriashing/akihq branch release/akibusiness-operations-brand-v1, not main; canonical product is AkiBusiness operations.

notes: Do not insert app signing keys, provisioning profiles, personal details, reviewer passwords or store API keys in Git.
Do not publish android/.well-known/assetlinks.json or apple-app-site-association with guessed fingerprints/team IDs.
Respect AkiSuite cross-domain OAuth callback and application deep linking; each product must survive login, logout and password recovery.
No automatic purchase-flow enabling: review mobile digital subscription rules and local availability before release.
